app.name: Tata CLiQ Luxury Shopping App
app.description: Luxury fashion and lifestyle shopping app by Tata Unistore.

verdict.one_liner: Collects government IDs and biometric data, then shares it across the Tata Group for profiling and marketing.
verdict.summary: Tata CLiQ collects highly sensitive personal information including government ID details and thumb impressions, stores them on servers, and shares them across the Tata Group ecosystem and with partners for marketing, profiling, and loyalty programs. It also profiles your financial behavior and tracks you across sessions using device fingerprinting. While users can request deletion, data may persist on backups indefinitely.
verdict.recommendation_reason: The collection of government ID and biometric data (thumb impression) on external servers, combined with broad sharing across the Tata ecosystem for advertising and profiling, makes this an exceptionally poor privacy choice.

red.title: Government ID and thumb impression collected
red.plain_english: The app asks for your government ID documents and thumb impression. This sensitive identity and biometric data is stored on their servers and shared with Tata Group companies and business partners.

red.title: Data shared across Tata Group and partners
red.plain_english: Your personal information is shared with Tata Group Entities, Partners, and Service Providers for marketing, profiling, loyalty programs, and business operations. This includes your identity, financial, and biometric data.

red.title: Financial data used to build your profile
red.plain_english: The app stores your payment details, transaction history, and spending patterns. It uses this financial data to generate insights about your behavior and send you targeted offers, including financial products.

red.title: Device fingerprinting for tracking
red.plain_english: The app uses cookies as unique identifiers to recognize your device across sessions. It collects your IP address, operating system, browser type, and device details to track and profile you.

red.title: Extensive behavioral tracking for ads
red.plain_english: Tata CLiQ uses cookies, pixels, and similar technologies to track your browsing and app usage. It analyzes this data to understand your preferences and deliver personalized marketing and recommendations.

green.title: You can request data deletion
green.plain_english: You have the right to request deletion or removal of your data from their systems. You can also request correction of inaccurate information.

green.title: Opt-out available for marketing
green.plain_english: You can choose not to receive marketing emails by clicking the unsubscribe link, and you can opt out of some uses of your data for marketing purposes.

green.title: Service providers bound by security contracts
green.plain_english: Third parties that process your data must follow express instructions, implement technical and organizational security measures, and maintain confidentiality obligations.

green.title: Data stored on servers in India
green.plain_english: The company states that data collected under this privacy policy is hosted on servers located in India.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention whether the app accesses your camera or microphone.
categories.detail: The policy is silent on camera and microphone access. As a shopping app, it may use the camera for scanning or photo uploads, but this is not disclosed.
concerns: Policy does not disclose camera or microphone usage

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention whether the app accesses your location or GPS.
categories.detail: The policy does not explicitly discuss location or GPS access. It collects IP addresses and browsing details, but GPS is not addressed.
concerns: Policy does not disclose location or GPS usage

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention whether the app accesses your contacts or phonebook.
categories.detail: The policy is silent on contacts or phonebook access. There is no mention of reading, uploading, or sharing contact information.
concerns: Policy does not disclose contacts or phonebook usage

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention whether the app accesses your device storage or files.
categories.detail: The policy does not explicitly discuss storage or file access beyond cookies and pixels placed on the device for tracking purposes.
concerns: Policy does not disclose storage or file access permissions

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Your data is shared with Tata Group Entities, Partners, and Service Providers for marketing, profiling, and loyalty programs.
categories.detail: The policy describes broad sharing with Tata Group Entities, Partners, the Tata Consumer Platform, and Service Providers. Data is shared for marketing, promotional campaigns, profiling, user analysis, payment processing, and business transfers. Some opt-out is available for marketing uses.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may share your Data with TATA Group Entities, Partners and Service Providers... for purposes of enrolment, offering you products, services and benefits.
concerns: Data shared with Tata Group Entities and Partners for marketing and profiling
Business transfers may include your data as part of transactions
Service providers handle profiling, user analysis, and payment processing

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: The app collects your government ID documents and links your identity to marketing and advertising profiles across the Tata ecosystem.
categories.detail: Collected data includes name, email, address, phone number, age, sex, date of birth, marital status, nationality, government ID documents, thumb impression, and occupation. This is used for account management, marketing campaigns based on your profile, and shared across the Tata ecosystem.
categories.policy_excerpt: Personal information: Age, sex, date of birth, marital status, nationality, details of government identification documents provided, thumb impression, occupation.
concerns: Government ID and thumb impression collected and stored on servers
Identity data linked to advertising and marketing profiles
Shared with Tata Group Entities and Partners

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: The app tracks your behavior using cookies, pixels, and device details to deliver personalized ads and recommendations.
categories.detail: Tata CLiQ uses cookies, pixels, and similar technologies to collect browsing details, device details, and app usage. It generates insights about customer behavior, patterns, and trends to provide personalized offers, recommendations, and marketing campaigns.
categories.policy_excerpt: We use cookies, pixels and similar technologies to receive and store certain types of information whenever you interact with us.
concerns: Behavioral tracking for personalized marketing and recommendations
Cookies and pixels used to recognize your device across sessions
Spending patterns analyzed to target financial product offers

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: The app says it is not for minors under 18, but there is no real age verification to enforce this.
categories.detail: The policy states that users under 18 may only use the Platforms with the involvement of a parent or guardian. There is no technical age verification mechanism described.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you are under 18, you may use our Platforms only with the involvement of a parent or guardian.
concerns: No age verification mechanism described

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: The app logs your IP address, browsing details, and device details, then uses them to profile you and understand your behavior.
categories.detail: The policy collects IP addresses, operating system details, browsing details, device details, and language settings. This is aggregated to measure visits, time spent, and pages viewed, and used for site improvement, safety, security, performance enhancement, and generating customer behavior insights.
categories.policy_excerpt: Our web servers or affiliates who provide analytics and performance enhancement services collect IP addresses, operating system details, browsing details, device details and language settings.
concerns: IP address and browsing details collected automatically
Network data used for profiling and behavior analysis

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: The app collects detailed device information and uses cookies as unique identifiers to recognize your device.
categories.detail: The policy collects IP addresses, operating system details, browsing details, device details, and language settings. It explicitly states that cookies are unique identifiers transferred to your device to enable their systems to recognize your device. Pixels and similar technologies are also used for traffic analysis.
categories.policy_excerpt: Cookies are unique identifiers that we transfer to your device to enable our systems to recognize your device.
concerns: Cookies used as unique identifiers for device recognition
Device details collected continuously for analytics and marketing

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: The app collects your thumb impression as personal data, stores it on servers, and shares it with Tata Group companies and partners.
categories.detail: Under personal information, the policy lists thumb impression as a category of collected data. This biometric data is stored on servers in India and may be shared with Tata Group Entities and Partners as part of the broader data sharing practices.
categories.policy_excerpt: Personal information: Age, sex, date of birth, marital status, nationality, details of government identification documents provided, thumb impression, occupation.
concerns: Thumb impression explicitly listed as collected personal information
Biometric data stored on external servers and shared with Tata ecosystem

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: The app stores your payment details and transaction history, then uses your spending patterns to target you with offers.
categories.detail: The policy collects payment instrument information, transactions, transaction history, preferences, method, mode and manner of payment, and spending pattern or trends. This financial data is used to provide offers (including financial products), personalized services, recommendations, and to generate insights about customer behavior.
categories.policy_excerpt: Financial information: payment instrument information, transactions, transaction history, preferences, method, mode and manner of payment, spending pattern or trends, and other similar data.
concerns: Payment and transaction data stored by the company
Spending patterns used for profiling and targeted offers
Financial product offers generated based on your data

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can request deletion of your data, but some information may remain on backup or archival systems.
categories.detail: Users have the right to request deletion or removal of their data, as well as correction of inaccurate data. However, the policy states that even after deletion, data may persist on backup or archival media for audit, legal, tax, or regulatory purposes. Retention periods vary significantly depending on data type and purpose.
categories.policy_excerpt: Even if we delete your Data, including on account of exercise of your right under Clause 11 below, it may persist on backup or archival media for audit, legal, tax or regulatory purposes.
concerns: Data may persist on backups after deletion request
Retention periods vary and are not clearly defined

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Policy changes take effect immediately when posted, and continued use counts as acceptance.
categories.detail: The policy states that changes are effective as soon as they are accessible. Users are deemed to have accepted updated terms on first use or first purchase after changes. Email reminders may be sent, but there is no requirement for active re-consent.
categories.policy_excerpt: The updated version will be effective as soon as it is accessible. Any changes will be immediately posted on our Platforms and you are deemed to have accepted the terms of the updated Policy on your first use of our Platform or first purchase of the products and/or services following the alterations.
concerns: Continued use equals automatic acceptance of policy changes
